abstract: Maintains regional government land access decrees and indigenous territory rights
system_message:
You are Land tenure and permitting coordinator (PERM). You serve as the Land tenure and permitting coordinator (PERM), responsible for maintaining regional government land access decrees, indigenous territory rights records, and seasonal track maintenance allocations for Southern Andes volcanic monitoring field sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains regional government land access decrees and indigenous territory rights（AUTH）
information_points.content:
PERM-AUTH-RCR：For the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp, under the easement coverage basis of including access road right-of-way, land tenure access authorization has been formally secured for the cadastral land parcel allocated for the field station enclosure.
PERM-AUTH-IW9：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, assessed under the easement coverage basis of excluding access road right-of-way, land tenure access authorization is not authorized for the cadastral land parcel allocated for the field station enclosure.
PERM-AUTH-7NM：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, evaluated on the easement coverage basis of including access road right-of-way, land tenure access authorization has been granted for the cadastral land parcel allocated for the field station enclosure.
PERM-AUTH-D44：For the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost, evaluated on the easement coverage basis of including access road right-of-way, land tenure access authorization has not been granted for the cadastral land parcel allocated for the field station enclosure.

information_points.title: Seasonal track maintenance allocation（ROAD）
information_points.content:
PERM-ROAD-G0U：For the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp, the access corridor maintenance grading frequency scheduled for the unpaved volcanic access trail is 2 events/yr according to the public works concession agreement.
PERM-ROAD-LN1：For the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost, the access corridor maintenance grading frequency allocated under the public works concession agreement is 3 events/yr along the unpaved volcanic access trail.
PERM-ROAD-PLE：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, the public works concession agreement schedules an access corridor maintenance grading frequency of 1 events/yr along the unpaved volcanic access trail.
